appDescription: A vehicle safety app that helps the driver respond in the first minutes after a traffic accident: emergency call screen, accident response screen and a step-by-step accident summary.

function.name: OPEN_ACCIDENT_RESPONSE
function.description: Open the accident response screen of the safety app, which shows the emergency call, nearby help request, protect mode and accident summary buttons.

function.name: OPEN_ACCIDENT_GUIDE
function.description: Open the step-by-step accident summary in the safety app, where the driver checks actions taken, enters injuries and makes a QR code to share.

function.name: OPEN_EMERGENCY_CALL_SCREEN
function.description: Open the phone dial screen with the emergency number 119 entered. The call is not placed automatically; the user presses the call button.
